claims.text: Every adapter here exposes the same shape -- ``ask(prompt, *, role, timeout_s, model=None) -> VendorReply``
claims.why: No adapter classes or ask methods are defined in this chunk.

claims.text: This module produces EVIDENCE, never a decision.  :class:`VendorReply` carries no approve/reject/score/verdict/majority field and must never grow one
claims.why: VendorReply class not defined in this chunk.

claims.text: status here is a TRANSPORT status (did the bytes make the round trip), not a judgement about the work under review.
claims.why: STATUSES constant not defined in this chunk.

claims.text: Nothing here writes, edits, applies or promotes anything.
claims.why: No functions or classes with side effects are defined in this chunk to verify.
Referenced module not present in this chunk.

claims.text: codex runs ``exec --sandbox read-only`` with approvals off;
claims.why: No codex adapter defined in this chunk.

claims.text: claude runs ``-p`` with tools disallowed and NO ``dontAsk``;
claims.why: No claude adapter defined in this chunk.

claims.text: every subprocess is spawned in a FRESH EMPTY TEMP DIRECTORY that is not the repo, not a worktree and contains no repo files (see :func:`council_cwd`);
claims.why: council_cwd function not defined in this chunk.

claims.text: The secret floor runs PER FILE before any bytes leave the process: the PATH channel over each evidence path individually, the CONTENT channel per file, and a content-only backstop over the assembled prompt. A hit REFUSES the call (status="refused_by_floor"); there is no redact-and-send, and the runner is never invoked.
claims.why: floor_check function not defined in this chunk; secret_floor_rule and slice_egress_rule imported but not used here.

claims.text: OLLAMA_HOST is NEVER set, mutated or inherited by anything in this module.
claims.why: No reference to OLLAMA_HOST in this chunk.

claims.text: the host is passed explicitly per call, and whether it counts as local is decided by sensitivity.lane_for_host
claims.why: lane_for_host imported but not used in this chunk.

claims.text: NUMERIC LOOPBACK ONLY: localhost does NOT count, because a name is a DNS indirection the predicate cannot see through.
claims.why: Referenced predicate not present in this chunk.

claims.text: codex and agy default to lane='untrusted': the allow-list / default-deny tier is ON for them, and withheld paths are named.
claims.why: No default lane assignment code in this chunk.

claims.text: Council records are NEVER an input to memory recall, and nothing in this module touches memstore.
claims.why: No import of memstore or memory recall in this chunk.
